game.targetPlatform: Nintendo Switch 2 (Nintendo Switch version, via backward compatibility)
game.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City – The Definitive Edition
game.notes: Port Mode from the PS4/PS5 list (34 trophies: 1 Platinum, 5 Gold, 9 Silver, 19 Bronze). City Sleuth tier conflicts between sources (Gold on gtabase, Silver on PowerPyx); Gold kept because it is the only assignment consistent with the 5/9/19 totals. Conservative build at the player's request: the only in-game counters treated as confirmed are the Pause > Stats completion percentage plus the specific Stats rows the player accepted at checkpoint (Criminal Rating; Vice City media attention and property damage; San Andreas attribute bars and weapon skills) - those rows are medium-confidence, sourced from guides rather than a captured Definitive Edition screen; every native entry that depends on an unconfirmed cumulative counter was filtered (Rule 1-2). Several such activities remain covered implicitly by the 100% completion trophy, whose percentage IS shown in Stats. Mission-condition trophies are verified by what the player observes before the Mission Passed screen; mission replay for passed story missions is unconfirmed for the Definitive Edition (one guide says none exists), so those are flagged MISSABLE as the safe assumption. Story mission totals are disputed across sources, so no trophy cites a mission count. Social Club accomplishments quoted by gtabase/gta.wiki are not console-native and were not imported. The Switch has no native trophies, so cheats have no gating effect here; the list assumes a cheat-free save. Take the Cannoli requires patch 1.02 or later.

trophies.name: Legal Counsel
trophies.verification: 'Riot' shows Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Iron-y
trophies.description: Kill the property developer with a Golf Club during 'Four Iron'. ⚠️ MISSABLE
trophies.verification: The developer dies to a Golf Club hit before Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Chopper'd Up
trophies.description: In 'Demolition Man', kill every hostile using the RC chopper's blades. ⚠️ MISSABLE
trophies.verification: Every hostile on each floor is killed by the RC chopper before the bombs are planted, and Mission Passed appears.

trophies.name: Life of the Party
trophies.verification: 'All Hands On Deck!' shows Mission Passed.

trophies.name: South American Connection
trophies.verification: 'Supply & Demand' shows Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Salutations My Little Friend
trophies.description: Use the M4 to take out Diaz during 'Rub Out'. ⚠️ MISSABLE
trophies.verification: Diaz dies to M4 fire before Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Not my First Time
trophies.description: Complete 'G-Spotlight' without falling from the rooftops. ⚠️ MISSABLE
trophies.verification: Tommy reaches the final rooftop without falling and the mission passes.

trophies.name: Big Heat from Little Havana
trophies.verification: 'Trojan Voodoo' shows Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Chauffeur
trophies.verification: 'Publicity Tour' shows Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Tommy Two-Wheels
trophies.verification: 'Hog Tied' shows Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Mischief Managed
trophies.verification: 'Keep Your Friends Close...' ends and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Gun for Hire
trophies.description: Complete every assassination contract: Road Kill, Waste the Wife, Autocide, Check Out at the Check In and Loose Ends.
trophies.verification: All five contract missions show Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Running Rampant
trophies.description: Complete Vigilante level 12 in a single run.
trophies.verification: The on-screen Vigilante level reaches 12 in a single run.

trophies.name: Somebody Call the Wambulance?
trophies.description: Complete Paramedic level 12 in a single run.
trophies.verification: The on-screen Paramedic level reaches 12 in a single run.

trophies.name: Just Like the Real Thing
trophies.verification: The RC Bandit Race ends with a first-place result.

trophies.name: Keepie-Uppy Okie Dokie
trophies.description: Score 5 with the Keepie-Uppy beach ball.
trophies.verification: The on-screen Keepie-Uppy score reaches 5.

trophies.name: Street Legend
trophies.description: Win all six street races: Terminal Velocity, Ocean Drive, Border Run, Capital Cruise, Tour! and V.C. Endurance.
trophies.verification: Each race ends with a first-place result.

trophies.name: Neon Arena
trophies.description: Win the Hotring, Bloodring and Dirtring events at the Hyman Memorial Stadium (events run 20:00-00:00 in-game and rotate daily).
trophies.verification: Each stadium event ends with its first-place / event-won result screen.

trophies.name: Grand Theft Auto
trophies.description: Deliver every wanted vehicle to the Sunshine Autos import garage.
trophies.verification: Every vehicle on all Sunshine Autos lists is marked delivered at the garage.

trophies.name: Greasy Palms
trophies.description: Use a police bribe to reduce your wanted level.
trophies.verification: A wanted star disappears from the HUD as the bribe is collected.

trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can
trophies.verification: Six wanted stars are lit on the HUD.

trophies.name: Bull in a China Shop
trophies.verification: The property damage row in Pause > Stats reads $1,000,000 or more.

trophies.name: I'm Famous!
trophies.description: Earn the 'Stuff of Legends' media attention rank.
trophies.verification: The best media attention row in Pause > Stats reads 'Stuff of Legends'.

trophies.name: Bloodstained Hands
trophies.verification: Pause > Stats shows the criminal rating title 'Butcher' or higher.

trophies.name: Take the Cannoli
trophies.verification: Pause > Stats shows the criminal rating title 'Godfather' (100,000 rating threshold since patch 1.02; keep the game updated).

trophies.name: Done it All
trophies.verification: Pause > Stats shows 100% completion.

trophies.name: The Vercetti Empire
trophies.verification: All base-game trophies show as earned.

excluded.reason: Native Platinum replaced by Pantheon's original thematic Platinum.
Listen to every radio station — the game does not record which stations were heard.
Hit max speed in a Deluxo — there is no speedometer to confirm the condition; arbitrary action.
Cumulative 25 taxi passengers — no confirmed in-game counter.
Cumulative 10 fires — no confirmed in-game counter.
Cumulative 10 pizza deliveries — no confirmed in-game counter.
Own 10 properties - no owned-property counter confirmed and sources disagree on what counts as a property (15/17/18).
30-second wheelie - no confirmed on-screen wheelie timer in the Definitive Edition.
100 hidden packages - no confirmed running package count; packages remain required by Done it All (100%).
36 unique jumps — per-jump bonus shown but no confirmed running total; jumps remain required by the 100% trophy.
